<style>
/* ── ELEMENTOR RESET ── */
.elementor-widget-html > .elementor-widget-container {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  max-width: none !important;
}

.elementor-element:has(.elementor-widget-html > .elementor-widget-container > .kf-page) {
  max-width: none !important;
  width: 100vw !important;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
  margin-right: calc(50% - 50vw) !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
}

.elementor-element:has(.kf-page) > .elementor-widget-wrap,
.elementor-element:has(.kf-page) > .elementor-container,
.elementor-element:has(.kf-page) > .e-con-inner {
  max-width: none !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* ── SCOPED RESET ── */
.kf-page {
  --navy: #2f4156;
  --navy2: #243347;
  --text: #1a1a1a;
  --muted: #6b6b6b;
  --faint: #a0a0a0;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --off: #f7f7f5;
  --border: #e8e8e4;
  --gold: #f5a623;
  --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);

  font-family: var(--sans) !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  line-height: 1.6 !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
  background: var(--white) !important;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  display: block !important;
  position: relative !important;
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

.kf-page *, .kf-page *::before, .kf-page *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  line-height: inherit !important;
}

.kf-page a { text-decoration: none !important; color: inherit !important; }
.kf-page img { display: block !important; max-width: 100% !important; }
.kf-page button { font-family: var(--sans) !important; }

/* ── SCROLL REVEAL ── */
.kf-page .sr {
  opacity: 0 !important;
  transform: translateY(28px) !important;
  transition: opacity 0.65s var(--ease), transform 0.65s var(--ease) !important;
}
.kf-page .sr.sr-left { transform: translateX(-28px) !important; }
.kf-page .sr.sr-right { transform: translateX(28px) !important; }
.kf-page .sr.sr-scale { transform: scale(0.96) !important; }
.kf-page .sr.in { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }
.kf-page .sr-d1 { transition-delay: 0.08s !important; }
.kf-page .sr-d2 { transition-delay: 0.16s !important; }
.kf-page .sr-d3 { transition-delay: 0.24s !important; }
.kf-page .sr-d4 { transition-delay: 0.32s !important; }

/* ── HERO ── */
.kf-page .kf-hero {
  position: relative !important;
  height: 92vh !important;
  min-height: 560px !important;
  max-height: 820px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: flex-end !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-hero-img {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  will-change: transform !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 70%, rgba(0,0,0,0.78) 100%),
    url('https://staging.dagpakketverhuur.nl/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Social-media-Kit-Dagpakketverhuur-4.png') center/cover no-repeat !important;
  transform: scale(1.08) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-hero-content {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  padding: 0 48px 60px !important;
  max-width: 1160px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-hero-tag {
  display: inline-block !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55) !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-hero h1 {
  font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  line-height: 1.02 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em !important;
  margin-bottom: 22px !important;
  max-width: 760px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-hero h1 em {
  font-style: italic !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-hero-meta {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-hero-pill {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 7px !important;
  padding: 9px 16px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18) !important;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92) !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-hero-cta {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  padding: 14px 28px !important;
  background: #fff !important;
  color: var(--navy) !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-hero-cta:hover { background: #f0f0ee !important; transform: translateY(-1px) !important; }

@keyframes kfFadeUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ── LAYOUT ── */
.kf-page .kf-w {
  max-width: 1160px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: 0 32px !important;
}

/* ── INTRO ── */
.kf-page .kf-intro {
  padding: 80px 0 72px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-intro-inner {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 400px !important;
  gap: 80px !important;
  align-items: start !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-eyebrow {
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.13em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  color: var(--navy) !important;
  display: block !important;
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-intro-left h2 {
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 42px) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  line-height: 1.08 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
  margin-bottom: 22px !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-intro-left p {
  font-size: 16px !important;
  color: #444 !important;
  line-height: 1.78 !important;
  margin-bottom: 18px !important;
  max-width: 520px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-joris {
  background: var(--off) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
  border-radius: 18px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  position: sticky !important;
  top: 100px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-joris-img {
  width: 100% !important;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3 !important;
  background: #cdd !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  color: #999 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-joris-img img { width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; object-fit: cover !important; }

.kf-page .kf-joris-body { padding: 22px 24px 26px !important; }

.kf-page .kf-joris-quote {
  font-size: 15px !important;
  line-height: 1.68 !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
  font-style: italic !important;
  margin-bottom: 18px !important;
  position: relative !important;
  padding-left: 16px !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-joris-quote::before {
  content: '' !important;
  position: absolute !important;
  left: 0 !important; top: 4px !important; bottom: 4px !important;
  width: 3px !important;
  background: var(--navy) !important;
  border-radius: 2px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-joris-name {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-joris-avatar {
  width: 38px !important; height: 38px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--navy) !important;
  display: flex !important; align-items: center !important; justify-content: center !important;
  color: #fff !important; font-size: 15px !important; font-weight: 700 !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-joris-info strong { display: block !important; font-size: 13px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: var(--text) !important; }
.kf-page .kf-joris-info span { font-size: 12px !important; color: var(--muted) !important; }

.kf-page .kf-joris-wa {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  margin-top: 18px !important;
  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  background: #25d366 !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-joris-wa:hover { background: #1dba57 !important; transform: translateY(-1px) !important; }

/* ── CATEGORIEEN ── */
.kf-page .kf-cats {
  padding: 80px 0 !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-cats-header { margin-bottom: 40px !important; }

.kf-page .kf-cats-header h2 {
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 38px) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em !important;
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-cats-header p {
  font-size: 15px !important;
  color: var(--muted) !important;
  max-width: 480px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-cats-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-cat {
  display: block !important;
  position: relative !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  aspect-ratio: 1/1 !important;
  transition: transform 0.28s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.28s var(--ease) !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-cat:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.01) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.18) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-cat-img {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  background: #2a3a4a !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-cat-img img {
  width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
  display: block !important;
  transition: transform 0.55s var(--ease) !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-cat:hover .kf-cat-img img { transform: scale(1.07) !important; }

.kf-page .kf-cat-overlay {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 20%, rgba(0,0,0,0.70) 100%) !important;
  transition: opacity 0.3s !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-cat:hover .kf-cat-overlay { opacity: 0.88 !important; }

.kf-page .kf-cat-body {
  position: absolute !important;
  bottom: 0 !important; left: 0 !important; right: 0 !important;
  padding: 18px 20px 22px !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-cat-name {
  font-size: 17px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  line-height: 1.2 !important;
}

/* ── REVIEW ── */
.kf-page .kf-review-big {
  padding: 80px 0 !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
  background: var(--off) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-review-big-inner {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important;
  gap: 80px !important;
  align-items: center !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-stars { display: flex !important; gap: 4px !important; margin-bottom: 22px !important; }
.kf-page .kf-star { color: var(--gold) !important; font-size: 20px !important; }

.kf-page .kf-review-big-quote {
  font-size: clamp(17px, 2vw, 23px) !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  line-height: 1.52 !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
  margin-bottom: 26px !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-review-big-author {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-review-big-avatar {
  width: 44px !important; height: 44px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--navy) !important;
  display: flex !important; align-items: center !important; justify-content: center !important;
  color: #fff !important; font-size: 16px !important; font-weight: 700 !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-review-big-author strong { display: block !important; font-size: 14px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: var(--text) !important; }
.kf-page .kf-review-big-author span { font-size: 13px !important; color: var(--muted) !important; }

.kf-page .kf-review-big-photo {
  border-radius: 18px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3 !important;
  background: #ccc !important;
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  color: #999 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-review-big-photo img { width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; object-fit: cover !important; }

.kf-page .kf-more-reviews {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  margin-top: 22px !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  color: var(--navy) !important;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--navy) !important;
  padding-bottom: 1px !important;
  transition: gap 0.2s !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-more-reviews:hover { gap: 10px !important; }

/* ── REGIO'S ── */
.kf-page .kf-regio-sec {
  padding: 80px 0 !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-regio-blok {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important;
  gap: 64px !important;
  align-items: start !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-regio-blok-left h2 {
  font-size: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 28px) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em !important;
  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
  margin-top: 8px !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-regio-blok-left p {
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: var(--muted) !important;
  line-height: 1.65 !important;
  max-width: 360px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-regio-pills {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  padding-top: 4px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-regio-pill {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 5px !important;
  padding: 8px 14px !important;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border) !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  color: var(--navy) !important;
  background: #fff !important;
  transition: background 0.18s, border-color 0.18s, transform 0.18s !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-regio-pill:hover {
  background: #eef2f6 !important;
  border-color: var(--navy) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px) !important;
}

/* ── FAQ ── */
.kf-page .kf-faq-sec {
  padding: 80px 0 !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-faq-inner {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr !important;
  gap: 80px !important;
  align-items: start !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-faq-left h2 {
  font-size: clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 32px) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-faq-left p {
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: var(--muted) !important;
  line-height: 1.65 !important;
  margin-bottom: 24px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-faq-wa {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  padding: 12px 20px !important;
  background: #25d366 !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-faq-wa:hover { background: #1dba57 !important; transform: translateY(-1px) !important; }

.kf-page .kf-faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important; }

.kf-page .kf-faq-q {
  width: 100% !important;
  text-align: left !important;
  padding: 18px 0 !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
  background: none !important;
  border: none !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
  transition: color 0.2s !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-faq-q:hover { color: var(--navy) !important; }

.kf-page .kf-faq-icon {
  width: 24px !important; height: 24px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--off) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
  display: flex !important; align-items: center !important; justify-content: center !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  transition: background 0.22s, transform 0.3s var(--ease), border-color 0.22s !important;
  color: var(--navy) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-faq-item.open .kf-faq-icon {
  background: var(--navy) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  border-color: var(--navy) !important;
  transform: rotate(45deg) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-faq-a {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  max-height: 0 !important;
  transition: max-height 0.45s var(--ease), padding 0.3s !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: #555 !important;
  line-height: 1.7 !important;
  padding: 0 36px 0 0 !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-faq-item.open .kf-faq-a {
  max-height: 600px !important;
  padding-bottom: 18px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-steps-anim {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  padding-top: 8px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-step-anim {
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: flex-start !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  transform: translateY(10px) !important;
  transition: opacity 0.4s var(--ease), transform 0.4s var(--ease) !important;
}
.kf-page .kf-step-anim:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s !important; }
.kf-page .kf-step-anim:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.13s !important; }
.kf-page .kf-step-anim:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.21s !important; }
.kf-page .kf-step-anim:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.29s !important; }

.kf-page .kf-faq-item.open .kf-step-anim {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  transform: translateY(0) !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-step-anim-num {
  width: 34px !important; height: 34px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--navy) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  font-size: 13px !important; font-weight: 800 !important;
  display: flex !important; align-items: center !important; justify-content: center !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  margin-top: 2px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-step-anim-content { padding-bottom: 4px !important; }
.kf-page .kf-step-anim-content strong { display: block !important; font-size: 14px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; margin-bottom: 2px !important; color: var(--text) !important; }
.kf-page .kf-step-anim-content span { font-size: 13.5px !important; color: var(--muted) !important; line-height: 1.6 !important; }

.kf-page .kf-step-anim-line {
  width: 2px !important; height: 18px !important;
  background: var(--border) !important;
  margin-left: 16px !important;
  border-radius: 2px !important;
}

/* ── CTA ── */
.kf-page .kf-cta { padding: 80px 0 !important; }

.kf-page .kf-cta-inner {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto !important;
  gap: 40px !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  background: var(--navy) !important;
  border-radius: 22px !important;
  padding: 56px 60px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-cta-inner h2 {
  font-size: clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 34px) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}

.kf-page .kf-cta-inner p { font-size: 15px !important; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6) !important; }

.kf-page .kf-cta-btns {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;

<script>
(function() {
  // Scroll reveal
  var srEls = document.querySelectorAll('.kf-page .sr');

    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('in');
        io.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1 });
  srEls.forEach(function(el) { io.observe(el); });

  // Parallax hero
  var parallax = document.getElementById('kf-parallax');
  if (parallax) {
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
      parallax.style.transform = 'scale(1.08) translateY(' + (window.scrollY * 0.25) + 'px)';
    }, { passive: true });
  }

  // FAQ accordion
  document.querySelectorAll('.kf-page .kf-faq-q').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var item = this.closest('.kf-faq-item');
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
      document.querySelectorAll('.kf-page .kf-faq-item').forEach(function(i) { i.classList.remove('open'); });
      if (!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
    });
  });
})();
